{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import System.Environment (getEnv, lookupEnv, getArgs)
import System.Exit (exitFailure)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum, ord)
import Data.List (intercalate)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

-- | LDAP filter escape per RFC 4515
escapeLDAPChar :: Char -> String
escapeLDAPChar '\\' = "\\5c"
escapeLDAPChar '*'  = "\\2a"
escapeLDAPChar '('  = "\\28"
escapeLDAPChar ')'  = "\\29"
escapeLDAPChar '\0' = "\\00"
escapeLDAPChar c
  | ord c > 127 = "\\" ++ hexEncode c
  | otherwise   = [c]

hexEncode :: Char -> String
hexEncode c = let h = showHex (ord c) "" in if length h == 1 then '0':h else h
  where showHex n s = let digits = "0123456789abcdef"
                          (q, r) = n `divMod` 16
                      in if q == 0 then (digits !! r) : s
                         else showHex q ((digits !! r) : s)

sanitizeLDAP :: String -> String
sanitizeLDAP = concatMap escapeLDAPChar

-- | Configuration record
data LDAPConfig = LDAPConfig
  { ldapHost       :: String
  , ldapPort       :: Int
  , ldapBaseDN     :: String
  , ldapBindDN     :: String
  , ldapSearchAttr :: String
  , ldapFilterTpl  :: String
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Safely parse an integer, returning a default on failure
safeReadInt :: Int -> String -> Int
safeReadInt def s =
  case reads s of
    [(n, "")] -> n
    _         -> def

-- | Load config from environment with defaults
loadConfig :: IO LDAPConfig
loadConfig = do
  host <- fromMaybe "ldap://localhost" <$> lookupEnv "LDAP_HOST"
  port <- maybe 389 (safeReadInt 389) <$> lookupEnv "LDAP_PORT"
  baseDN <- fromMaybe "dc=example,dc=com" <$> lookupEnv "LDAP_BASE_DN"
  bindDN <- fromMaybe "cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com" <$> lookupEnv "LDAP_BIND_DN"
  searchAttr <- fromMaybe "uid" <$> lookupEnv "LDAP_SEARCH_ATTR"
  filterTpl <- fromMaybe "(&(objectClass=person)({attr}={value}))" <$> lookupEnv "LDAP_FILTER_TEMPLATE"
  return LDAPConfig
    { ldapHost = host
    , ldapPort = port
    , ldapBaseDN = baseDN
    , ldapBindDN = bindDN
    , ldapSearchAttr = searchAttr
    , ldapFilterTpl = filterTpl
    }

-- | Build LDAP filter from template - always sanitizes
buildFilter :: LDAPConfig -> String -> String
buildFilter cfg userInput =
  let attr = ldapSearchAttr cfg
      tpl = ldapFilterTpl cfg
      -- Always apply sanitization unconditionally
      processedInput = sanitizeLDAP userInput
      -- Template substitution
      result = templateSubst tpl (Map.fromList [("attr", attr), ("value", processedInput)])
  in result

-- | Simple template substitution: replaces {key} with value
templateSubst :: String -> Map.Map String String -> String
templateSubst [] _ = []
templateSubst ('{':rest) vars =
  case break (== '}') rest of
    (key, '}':remaining) ->
      case Map.lookup key vars of
        Just val -> val ++ templateSubst remaining vars
        Nothing  -> '{' : key ++ "}" ++ templateSubst remaining vars
    _ -> '{' : templateSubst rest vars
templateSubst (c:rest) vars = c : templateSubst rest vars

-- | Validate attribute name (alphanumeric + hyphen only)
validateAttr :: String -> Either String String
validateAttr [] = Left "Empty attribute name"
validateAttr s
  | all (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '-') s = Right s
  | otherwise = Left $ "Invalid attribute name: " ++ s

-- | Simulate LDAP search (in real code this would use ldap-client)
performSearch :: LDAPConfig -> String -> IO ()
performSearch cfg query = do
  putStrLn $ "[DEBUG] Connecting to: " ++ ldapHost cfg ++ ":" ++ show (ldapPort cfg)
  putStrLn $ "[DEBUG] Base DN: " ++ ldapBaseDN cfg
  putStrLn $ "[DEBUG] Filter: " ++ query
  putStrLn $ "[INFO] Search executed successfully"

-- | Main entry point
main :: IO ()
main = do
  args <- getArgs
  case args of
    [] -> do
      putStrLn "Usage: ldap-lookup <username>"
      exitFailure
    (username:_) -> do
      cfg <- loadConfig
      case validateAttr (ldapSearchAttr cfg) of
        Left err -> do
          putStrLn $ "Configuration error: " ++ err
          exitFailure
        Right _ -> do
          let filterStr = buildFilter cfg username
          performSearch cfg filterStr
